generatorReview: The diff contains only module-path and generated-video-path rebasing; generated theme source was read, not executed.
positiveFindings: The preparation helper/manifest/plan hashes match the reviewed bytes; seven file size and SHA256 pins and six repository source pins match.
The synthetic store contains one request and one archive; the archive has one compiled fixture theme and two synthetic game descriptors.
Input path and symlink checks, exact namespace, fresh evidence directory and fresh container name fail closed.
No app API, account, credentials, production package store or network mount is used. Docker receives only the fresh read-only source bind and disposable output bind.

The container uses --pull=never, --network none, read-only root, UID/GID 65534, all capabilities dropped and no-new-privileges. The host controller is the Docker operator; the builder itself is non-root.
One CPU, 768 MiB memory with no additional swap, 48 PIDs, 45-second worker timeout, 8 MiB file limit and 64 MiB noexec/nosuid tmpfs are explicit.

Worker success requires exact output inventory, regular non-symlink bounded files, matching source and output SHA256, mediaValidated true, expected toolchain string and exactly the expected compiled theme with nonempty JavaScript.
Source is rehashed after execution. Cleanup inspects the exact container owner label before removal and verifies absence; any failed cleanup changes the receipt to FAIL.
The helper adds no image build/pull, persistent service or timer change. Retained files are scoped evidence, not customer installation.

findings.title: Prepared immutable image is absent
findings.detail: The reviewed image-readiness.json records No such image for the exact sha256 image. This is an unresolved prerequisite, not a failed worker execution. The helper fails closed without pulling, building or substituting an image.
findings.resolution: Restore the exact trusted image separately, or revise and re-review the immutable replacement image, input manifest and helper pins. This review executed no Docker command.

findings.title: Repository hashes do not attest image contents
findings.detail: All six sourcePins match the repository, but the helper never compares those files inside the image. sourceCandidate in its output is supplied by the manifest. package-builder.ts enforces actual esbuild 0.28.2, while the React and ffmpeg labels in result.toolchain are literals.
findings.resolution: The separately reviewed image restoration must provide trustworthy image-to-code/toolchain provenance before describing the smoke as verification of the candidate compiler and exact React/ffmpeg versions. An immutable image ID alone identifies bytes but does not connect them to these source pins.

findings.title: Complementary component evidence is not a production end-to-end install
findings.detail: Prior nine-group theme browser evidence uses actual upload/preflight/review/install APIs with independent synthetic reviewer identity and installedGames empty, but its declarative worker result is explicitly synthetic. This prepared smoke calls the real compiled-theme builder directly and does not run the broker scheduler or feed its real output through the API test.
findings.resolution: After a successful smoke with established image provenance, report both the editor/API import contract and real compiler/media worker as independently verified components. Do not claim an actual customer install, a single joined end-to-end run, scheduler health, independent human content review or production executable-runtime readiness.

findings.title: Resource and media coverage has explicit limits
findings.detail: The controller bounds worker wall time, CPU, container memory/swap, PIDs, per-file size and tmpfs. The host capture_output buffers and aggregate bind-output disk usage have no separate quota. The fixed trusted fixture and builder output budgets make this acceptable for this one smoke; this is not a general untrusted-workload resource proof. The fixture exercises image, WAV and MP4 probes, carries Lottie, and includes no font.
findings.resolution: Keep the resource and media claims scoped to this pinned fixture. Do not claim font decoding or a global host-memory/disk bound.
